检查 HF 数据集的实际字段/结构：
```bash
cd /root/symb_invariant_consensus
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
python3 -c "
from datasets import load_dataset
# 看 depth-5 config 的字段
ds = load_dataset('tasksource/proofwriter', 'depth-5', split='train', trust_remote_code=True)
print('Fields:', ds.column_names)
print('Size:', len(ds))

    print(f'  {k}: {str(v)[:200]}')

    print('Has assumption field')
# 查看唯一值
```
